title: Winnipeg cardiologist takes on new role focused on women's heart health
desc: A Winnipeg cardiologist has been appointed to a new research chair aimed at improving how heart disease is studied and treated in women. Dr. Shelley Zieroth will serve as the Heart & Stroke, St. Boniface Hospital Foundation and Research Manitoba Chair in Women’s Clinical Heart Health Research. New chair focused on women's heart health In her new role, Zieroth will provide leadership in developing a Women's Heart Care program in Manitoba, advancing research, integrating best practices into clinical care and fostering collaboration with researchers across Canada and around the world. Heart disease remains one of the leading causes of death among women, while women have historically been underrepresented in cardiovascular research.
